title: Associations of prevalent disease with retinal layer thicknesses
bodyHtml:
Model: Y ~ X + age+age^2+Sex+SE+Self-ReportedEthnicity+Smoking

Y: GCL, GCC,…
X: Alcohol related disorders, Multiple sclerosis,…
projectSummary: Associations of prevalent disease with retinal layer thicknesses
dataPoints: linear_reg_CSI.csv, linear_reg_GCC.csv, linear_reg_GCL.csv, linear_reg_INL.csv, linear_reg_IPL.csv, linear_reg_ISOS-PS.csv, linear_reg_OPL.csv, linear_reg_RNFL.csv, linear_reg_RPE.csv
dataTableFormat:
{"data convert":[
{"type":"raw","field name":"Beta","raw field":"Estimate"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"Standard Error","raw field":"Std..Error"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"N_Cases","raw field":"N_Cases"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"N_Controls","raw field":"N_Controls"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"Trait","raw field":"x"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"P-value","raw field":"Pr...t.."},
{"type":"raw","field name":"FDR","raw field":"FDR"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"Category","raw field":"group"}],

visualizerConfiguration:
{"type":"phewas plot",
"group by": "Category",
"render by": "Trait",
"phenotype map":"null",
"y axis field": "FDR",
"convert y -log10":"true",
"y axis label": "FDR(-log10)",
"x axis label": "Trait",
"beta field": "null",
"hover content": ["FDR","P-value","Beta"],
"thresholds": ["0.05"],
"height": 550,
"star key":"phenotype",

dataVisualizerLegendHtml: The PheWAS plot shows the associations between different disorders/diseases and time to the selected retinal thickness.
